title: Inari Live procedural patterns
description: On-disk format of `<repo_root>/.inari/patterns.json` written by the procedural learner (Inari Live Sesión 12). Commit-friendly: stable key order, 2-space indent, integers only (no floats — score weighting lives in memory). Schema is informational; the learner does NOT runtime-validate against it. Update CURRENT_VERSION in `desktop/src-tauri/src/memory/procedural/mod.rs` when bumping `version`.

version.description: Schema version. The learner refuses to overwrite a file whose version is greater than its own CURRENT_VERSION.

patterns.description: Per-repo cap is MAX_PATTERNS_PER_REPO = 500. Anti-patterns are exempt from pruning.

kind.description: auto-detected = positive recall candidate. anti-pattern = explicit do-not-suggest signal.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex of the normalised error text. Computed by crate::memory::fingerprint::compute_error_fingerprint and mirrored cross-language (web, cli).

suggested_fix_summary.description: Human-readable description of the fix that worked (or the fix that failed for anti-patterns). Locked at first-write; later successes do not overwrite.

success_count.description: Total successful applications across all sessions for this fingerprint.

failure_count.description: Total failed applications (RemediationCompleted{success:false} + FixRejected) for this fingerprint.

evidence.description: Sample of contributing remediation_session ids, capped at MAX_EVIDENCE_PER_PATTERN. Oldest entries are dropped on overflow.

last_seen_ms.description: Unix epoch in ms — most-recent event that touched this pattern. Drives recency weighting in the matcher.

created_at_ms.description: Unix epoch in ms — first time this fingerprint was seen by the learner.
